  # NOTE: Slurm --mem=1gb not translated.

  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: log filename may not be unique unless you add uniqueness.

  . /home/rs/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
  conda activate mosdef-study38

  flux run -n 1 rsync -av /home/rs/space/projects/final_repro_methane/reproducibility_study/reproducibility_project/methane_systemsize_subproject4/* .
